svg.text: L298N with four BO motors (two parallel pairs) and the two pan-tilt servos.
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
Motors of a pair are wired in parallel with the same polarity; swap a pair's two wires if that side runs backwards.
Remove the ENA/ENB jumpers. ENx = PWM speed (D5/D6, ~980 Hz), INx = direction. Each channel handles 2 A.
SV1 tilt on D12: 70° floor / 95° level
Wires: orange = SIG, red = V+, brown = GND.
Servo current spikes are buffered by C1 470 µF
